source: sane-backends 1.4.0 xerox_mfp.conf comments, the sane-xerox_mfp manual, and one local Samsung Scan test

devices.limitations: The device did not report duplex. An eSCL capability request to the embedded web server returned HTTP 404 on the reference unit. That does not classify other models.
devices.evidence: sane-backends 1.4.0 scanimage option list plus a 40 mm flatbed scan through the Samsung Scan engine on 6 November 2026. ADF was previously completed from the command line; the 1.1 regression check does not pull paper.
